continuation_proved_scope: Folded convolution TP2 iff decreasing Turan defects; multiplicative and strict multiplicative closure
All m>=1, consecutive Fourier coefficient rows of (x+1)U_m(x+3/2) are strictly MLR ordered
All m>=0, U_m(x+3/2) has a strict folded-TP2 kernel and consecutive rows are strictly MLR ordered
For every k>=0, H(x+2)<=lr H((x+1) sum_{j=0}^k U_j(x+3/2))
All-depth matrix-gap determinant, transfer and conjugation identities
All adjacent sums U_r+U_(r-1), all prefix sums T_n, and yT_n for n>=1 have strict folded-TP2 kernels
The actual all-left multiplier B_k=2+2y+3y^2 T_(k+1) has a strict folded-TP2 kernel for every k>=0
Only the weak second sandwich H(p_(k+2))<=lr H((x+2)B_k) is needed: strictness then propagates by an explicit positive Cauchy-Binet term
For every r>=2, W_r=U_r-U_(r-1) has strict supported folded defects and strict consecutive Fourier MLR; this does not close the original S/D comparison
Strict original Local TP2 for every canonical all-left path L^k, k>=0, using a uniform proof for k>=6 and exact original bases k=0..5
Both parity intermediary comparisons H(S)<=lr H((2x+1)yT_(k+1)); actual proxy strictness from root-residue pair and mass certificates
First-difference convolution J_h TP2 iff delta_n/(h_n-h_(n+1)) is nonincreasing; multiplicative closure and conditional canonical reduction
Strict original Local TP2 for every canonical all-right path R^k, k>=0, using root-factor cones, parity sandwiches, and uniform quartic/linear correction certificates

Every canonical center, central-endpoint gap, child-center gap, S, M, and D has dense positive first differences; endpoint E is nonnegative at the root and dense positive elsewhere, by exact mutation induction
Strict original Local TP2 for every LR^k and RL^k, k>=0, by compatible resolvent kernels, uniform mass bounds for k>=4, prior ray theorem at k=0 and six exact original bases at k=1..3
Every canonical C-A-B has positive first-difference support; general first-sandwich and low-band second-sandwich reductions are conditional on explicitly stated kernel hypotheses
Strict original Local TP2 for every L^2R^k, k>=0, using relative-compatible kernels, all-k central mass bound >400 and strict proxy correction at threshold256
For every m>=0, the initial one-turn endpoint comparison and initial gap/correction orders are proved by positive identities and the established all-left theorem
For every pure-left g_m, m>=1, t_gm-a is 3-strong uniformly a in [-2,2]; every g_m is in the sufficient center cone F, without claiming mutation closure

Every lambda-strong folded kernel has det K[i,j;k,l]>=lambda K(i,k) when both diagonal entries are positive; coefficient domination and lambda>=8H(B)[0] imply exterior-square domination by four times K_B. Uniform strength of the one-turn midpoint family remains unproved.
For all m>=1, y^2 T_m is optimally 2^m-strong, T_m is 2^(m-1)-strong, and t_gm-a is 3*2^(m-1)-strong uniformly for a in [-2,2]
Every ordered kernel minor of F=T_(m+1)(t-r)(t-s) dominates four times the corresponding minor of B=T_(m-1), for all m>=1; this does not automatically pass to H=F+B(t-c)
The desired midpoint strength is proved on n>=2m+2 for all m>=1, with independently audited additional support-boundary bounds; the low-index band remains open
